def flow_augment(s, t, cap):

    for _ in range(1):
        for i in range(total_vertices):
            parent_node[i] = -1
        parent_node[s] = s
        flow_amount[s] = cap
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)

                    network[p][v] -= flow_amount[t]

                    flow_amount[v] = min(capacity, flow_amount[u])
                    q.append(v)
